Capabilities
/
Stainless steel machining
Stainless steel parts for your assembly

Stainless steel shafts, fittings and other custom components machined to your drawing.

Prepare RFQ email
Stainless steel turned shafts
Stainless steel shafts, fittings and hardware

Choose the grade and condition for the operating environment, then specify the treatment and final dimensions. The listed grades are not interchangeable; photographs do not verify the material of a pictured part.

Geometry & process
For corrosion-resistant shafts, fittings, valve parts and locking components. Shafts, flanges, grooves and threads can be combined with live-tool flats, cross-holes and engraving.
Size & workholding
Send a 3D model with the overall dimensions and stock size. Identify working diameters, shoulders and off-axis features so tool access, clamping space and the assembly datums can be reviewed.
Material & finish
303, 304, 316L and 17-4PH options serve different machining and operating requirements. Specify the grade and material condition, including any required heat treatment. Fine turning, polishing, passivation and electropolishing are offered across the stainless services. Specify the treatment and required final dimensions.
Grades to discuss

Stainless steel: SUS303 · SUS304 · SUS316 · SUS316L · SUS430 · SUS440

Specify the exact grade and condition. Corrosion, strength, finishing and documentation needs must be reviewed for the intended use.

Specify the working surfaces, not just the grade
More part examples
Browse all parts
Stainless steel turned parts
Indexing plungers & locking pins
Drawing & acceptance
Drawing requirements

Specify the grade and material condition, including any required heat treatment. Identify working diameters, threads and sealing or sliding surfaces.

State the service environment and selected surface treatment; corrosion resistance and compatibility must be evaluated for the actual application.

Inspection and acceptance

Define runout, diameter and thread checks in relation to the assembly datums. Mark surfaces where burrs or handling marks are unacceptable.

Request any material or treatment documents you need. Confirm their availability and contents before placing an order.

Agree the measurement method and required records before production.

Quality & inspection
Equipment and order records
Prepare your stainless steel machining enquiry

Include grade, condition, finish, quantity and mating-part requirements with a controlled drawing.

If passivation or electropolishing is requested, specify the applicable requirements and the dimensions that must be accepted after treatment.

Prepare RFQ email

Add your requirements to the email draft, then attach drawings in your email app before sending.
